'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come in, sit by the fire. We need to talk. Tarkov needs to cleansed. Our next target is a former cop known as Kollontay. He was causing trouble even before everything fell apart, and now he's only gotten worse. Find him and deal with him. They say he's holed up in the MVD academy downtown.}}

==Requirements== 
* Obtain level 2 loyalty with [[Jaeger]]

==Objectives==
* Locate and neutralize [[Kollontay]]
* Hand over the found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Kollontay]]'s [[PR-Taran police baton|police baton]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Is it done? That's good to hear. A little less filth in our city. Here's your reward.}}
